p.i: Guidance for scenario 1: (Coreper-level) mandate for negotiations with the European Parliament (I item note)

content.p:
On …, the Commission submitted to the Council and the European Parliament a proposal for a Regulation/Directive/Decision of the European Parliament and of the Council …
12345/21. , which aims to …
The draft Regulation/Directive/Decision is based on Article … of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU) (ordinary legislative procedure).

(where applicable) The XXX delivered its opinion on …
Not yet published in the Official Journal. . / decided not to deliver an opinion on the proposal. / The opinion of XXX was requested on … (and is pending).
The [name of the Council preparatory body] discussed the proposal at its meetings on [dates] and has agreed on the text in the annex/annexes (or in addendum/addenda XX) to this note.

In the European Parliament, the Committee(s) on … has/have the lead responsibility. … was/were appointed rapporteur(s). The report was tabled on …; [the negotiating mandate was granted at the plenary session on … to start interinstitutional negotiations.] / [the European Parliament adopted its negotiating mandate at the plenary session on …, and the proposal was referred to the Committee(s) on … to start interinstitutional negotiations].

The Permanent Representatives Committee is therefore invited to confirm agreement on the text of the mandate for negotiations with the European Parliament, as set out in the annex/annexes (or in addendum/addenda XX) to this note, to enable the Presidency to conduct those negotiations.

In accordance with the approach to legislative transparency endorsed by Coreper on 14 July 2020
9493/20. , and in full consistency with Regulation 1049/2001 and the Council‘s Rules of Procedure, the mandate thus agreed will be made public unless the Permanent Representatives Committee objects.

p.i: Guidance for scenario 2: (Council-level) general approach – I/A or A item note

content.p:
On …, the Commission submitted to the Council and the European Parliament a proposal for a Regulation/Directive/Decision of the European Parliament and of the Council …

In the European Parliament , the Committee(s) on … has/have the lead responsibility. … was /were appointed rapporteur(s). The report was tabled on …; [the negotiating mandate was granted at the plenary session on … to start interinstitutional negotiations.] / [the European Parliament adopted its negotiating mandate at the plenary session on …, and the proposal was referred to the Committee(s) on … to start interinstitutional negotiations].

p.i: In case of an I/A item in Council

content.p: The Permanent Representatives Committee is therefore invited to:
confirm agreement on the text of the general approach, as set out in the annex/annexes (or in addendum/addenda XX) to this note, and

recommend that the Council reach a general approach as set out in the annex/annexes (or in addendum XX) to this note, through an ‘A’ item in one of its next meetings, to enable the Presidency to conduct those negotiations.

p.i: In case of an A item

content.p: At its meeting on …, the Permanent Representatives Committee (Part I/Part II) examined the text set out in the annex/annexes (or in addendum/addenda XX) and agreed to recommend that the Council reach a general approach.
The Council is therefore invited to reach a general approach as set out in the annex/annexes (or in addendum/addenda XX) to this note.

p.i: Guidance for scenario 3: Confirmation of the final compromise text with a view to agreement at first reading (I item note)

content.p:
On …, the Commission submitted to the Council and the European Parliament a proposal for a Regulation/Directive/Decision of the European Parliament and of the Council …
12345/21. , which aims to …
The draft Regulation/Directive/Decision is based on Article … of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU) (ordinary legislative procedure).

(where applicable) The XXX delivered its opinion on …
Not yet published in the Official Journal. . / decided not to deliver an opinion on the proposal. / The opinion of XXX was requested on … (and is pending).

(In case of a general approach) On …, the Council reached a general approach
12345/21. on the abovementioned proposal, which constituted the mandate for negotiations with the European Parliament in the context of the ordinary legislative procedure.
(In case of a Coreper-level mandate) At its meeting on …, the Permanent Representatives Committee granted the … Presidency a mandate to enter into negotiations with the European Parliament.
On …, a provisional agreement was reached between co-legislators, resulting in the final compromise text as set out in the annex/annexes (or in addendum/addenda XX) to this note.
The Permanent Representatives Committee is therefore invited to:

confirm agreement on the final compromise text as set out in the annex/annexes (or in addendum/addenda XX) to this note with a view to reaching an agreement at first reading with the European Parliament;

authorise the Chair of the Permanent Representatives Committee to send a letter to inform the Chair(s) of the European Parliament’s … Committee(s) that, should the European Parliament adopt its position at first reading on the text of the proposal in the exact form as set out in the annex/annexes (or in addendum/addenda XX) to this note, and subject to revision of that text by the lawyer-linguists of both institutions, the Council will approve the European Parliament’s position and the act will be adopted in the wording which corresponds to the European Parliament’s position.
